patterns.pattern: The muttering emanating from the sycophant increases to a sudden crescendo, and your head begins to spin.
A bloodleech leaps at you, clamping with teeth onto exposed flesh and secreting some foul toxin into your bloodstream.
^A bloodleech leaps at you, clamping with teeth onto exposed flesh and secreting some foul toxin into your bloodstream. You stumble as you are afflicted with (\w+)\.$
As a firelord glares at you, sudden agonising heat ignites in your veins. It is gone as swiftly as it came, but you feel suddenly lightheaded.
A worm spews a stream of maggots at you, and they begin burrowing into your flesh.
A chimera lets out a concussive roar, all three of the creatures heads thrown forward toward you.
^The roar washes over you, ripping apart your (.+) defence\.$
A bubonis scampers forward and clamps its fangs down upon your ankle, pumping some vile substance into your bloodstream.

^A lash of energy whips out of the chaos storm to strike you, afflicting you with (\w+).$
A withered crone totters toward you before brushing a single finger against your brow. Your mind explodes into a frenzy of maddened whispering at the contact.
A humbug scuttles forward and springs for your throat, attaching itself there for a brief instant.
^A humbug scuttles forward and springs for your throat, attaching itself there for a brief instant. Your head violently swims as you feel it bring the curse of (\w+) down upon you\.$
^(\w+) gestures sharply in your direction, and a mass of green slime flows up and over you, coating your skin\.$
